The '''Vault of Justice''' was a room within the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]], the complex of rooms that made up the base of the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Located deep within the labyrinth of rooms and halls, the Vault contained the ancient [[Force artifact/Legends|artifact]] known as the [[Neer's Gauntlet/Legends|Gauntlet]] of [[Neer/Legends|Neer]]. The room was forgotten during the evacuation of the planet during the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] and the contents of the room were left undisturbed as of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="NoP" />
